research_scope: Read-only bounded search for original MDE inspection observations of Aligned or Rowan/Bauxite physical construction at Quantum Frederick during May 22–August 20, 2026.

official_route.finding: The MDE Open Records page explicitly links the land, water and air inspection dashboards. The separate official Frederick Data Center Sampling/Reports page points back to this inspection route; it distinguishes the Aligned parcel from Rowan's three Bauxite parcels, but is undated and supplies no fresh inspection observations.

dataset_binding: Each captured public story's window.STORY_DATA dataSource.dataSourceList and visualization field schemas explicitly bind the stated dataset and columns. Only public JSON was parsed; no browser/session credentials, presigned source assets or internal APIs were used.

query.method: One ordinary credential-free GET per dataset with a documented SoQL name filter and limit 2000. Exact request URLs are preserved in local metadata.
query.where_logic: OR of uppercase name-field LIKE matches
query.date_filter_reason: Initial identity search was intended to recover site aliases and record URLs across dates before selecting the observation window.
query.result: All three queries returned HTTP403. Zero rows were recovered; this is not a zero-result search. No conclusion about existence or absence of inspections follows.

status_boundaries: The prior April 15, 2026 state report is outside the May 22 start of the observation window.

The parent reports that the July year-end report repeats the April overview paragraph. This subtask did not independently inspect either PDF and does not use the later publication date as a new physical observation.
No current-build status, completion state, company role, capacity or geometry is selected from dashboard accessibility, permit records or an undated identity page.
missing_gate: A newly available official dated inspection report or independent original operator/contractor/municipal physical-progress statement for an unfinished Aligned parcel project or unfinished Rowan Bauxite II/III campus scope, with exact project/date binding. Do not reopen the same denied queries or change API versions to work around this denial.
custody: The helper hashes every HTTP response but retains only successful bodies. Four successful public HTML bodies were independently rehashed; failed response bodies are not available for rehash. Failure metadata itself is separately hash-bound. Public story session fields and publisher assets stay in ignored raw custody, not this factual handoff.
